newsitem.title: USA: Premier enters vendor pact with BOC units.
newsitem.headline: Premier enters vendor pact with BOC units.

text.p: Premier Inc, an alliance of hospitals and health-care systems, on Wednesday said it entered a seven-year corporate partnership agreement with Ohmeda, a vender of anesthesia and critical care pharmaceuticals and equipment, and BOC Gases, which provides medical gases.
Both vendors are part of BOC Group Plc.

The agreement, which represents a prospective sales volume of about $2.2 billion over seven years, offers discounts and incentives on Ohmeda and BOC Gases products to Premier's 1,800 hospital and health-system owners and affiliates, Ohmeda said.

The corporate partnership and its related group purchasing agreements involve anesthesia-related pharmaceuticals, anesthesia delivery systems, bulk and cylinder medical gases, infant care products, respiratory gas monitors, suction and oxygen products and other critical care products.
